notes: Published sales drawings, not an as-built interior survey. The site massing remains the accepted 2022 scheme.
Floor elevations use estimated 3 m storeys, except the estimated 3.7 m A1 commercial ground storey; heights are not surveyed section measurements.
Apartment availability is not occupancy or a complete unit inventory. Missing catalogues are not reconstructed.
A1, B1-B4 and C1 now have sourced models. A2/C2/C3 remain unresolved.
Whole-floor inset linework is extracted directly from apartment catalogues. Filled apartment highlights, hatching and sheet annotations are omitted.
Outdoor gardens outside the typical-floor frame are clipped. Building interiors and balcony outlines inside that frame are retained.
B1 levels 2–8 use directly recovered publisher PDFs whose building and floor labels were visually verified. The A-41 scan was replaced by the vector A-42 sheet for level 4.
